LibrarySprite.description: A picture from the people-and-houses library (docs/MEDIA.md "Sprites and buildings"): one per key, generated once and cached forever. The bare plugin sends `status: off` with null `hash` and `url`; the server's media layer fills them (`pending`, then `ready` via GET /media/index; `off` = images off, refused by the budget or failed: draw your placeholder).

hash.description: The media key (null from the bare plugin or with images off).

LonLat.description: [longitude, latitude] in degrees (WGS84). Note the order: longitude first.

PersonLive.description: One person as `game.people` lists them: who they are (a sprite role and look), and what they are doing now.

doing.description: What they are doing, in a few words ("fishing off the dock", "asleep", "cheering Ash's Host").

group.description: People doing the same thing at the same spot in this reply share a small id (null: alone).

home_cell.description: Their house (a houses-level hex of their settlement).

look.description: Which of the role's three looks.

moving.description: A hint: they walk about doing it (toward `to_cell` when set).

name.description: Their name; a resident: "<role> of the <crowd>, who lives in the <house>".

ref.description: The person (`ch:`); null for a house's resident (not yet in the story).

resident.description: One of the people living in a house, drawn from a crowd of its settlement (no `ch:` ref until the story names them).

title.description: Their rank title, when they have one.

to_cell.description: Where they are heading or gathering (a hex key, any level).

why.description: What set it: their routine (role and time of day), or an event (an earth refuge, a mob, their own public act this beat, an army, their crowd's stance, fear).

work.description: What kind of place they work at.

work_cell.description: Where they work (a houses-level hex: the dock, the market, the temple, a field …).

Ref.description: A pointer to any row of the world: dg demigod, ch character, cl cluster, gr group, gd god, pl place, it item, ag agent, lg ledger row, ce cell, mb mob. Stable for the whole match.

description: `game.people`: every living person in the board disc around `cell` (named people and the residents of the houses), nearest first, each with their sprite and what they are doing now. Read-only and deterministic.

phase.description: The time of day (the routines follow it).

title: game.people

x-args.description: Over HTTP every arg is a query-string parameter (numbers as numeric strings). Unknown args are ignored.

cell.description: A hex cell key ("<face>:<level>:<q>:<r>"): the board's centre.

level.description: The board's level (default: the cell key's).

x-description: People and houses: every living person in the board disc (22 rings at `level`) around `cell`, nearest first (at most `limit`, default 100, most 300): name, sprite role (16) and look (3) with its library picture (`sprite`), and what they are doing now (`doing`, `activity`, `moving`, `to_cell`: an event reaction, else a routine by role and time of day), their home and work hexes and a small `group` id for people doing the same thing at the same spot. Read-only, deterministic, cheap.
